ideas.title: Investigating the ICE Shooting in Minneapolis
ideas.description: This story would investigate the ICE shooting in Minneapolis, including the circumstances surrounding the shooting and the FBI's handling of the investigation.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the ICE shooting in Minneapolis?
How has the FBI handled the investigation?
